rr rr #View PCA VizDimLoadings(dc, dims = 1:4, reduction = )

rr rr ## In particular DimHeatmap allows for easy exploration of the primary sources of heterogeneity in a dataset, and can be useful when trying to decide which PCs to include for further downstream analyses. Both cells and features are ordered according to their PCA scores. Setting cells to a number plots the ‘extreme’ cells on both ends of the spectrum, which dramatically speeds plotting for large datasets. Though clearly a supervised analysis, we find this to be a valuable tool for exploring correlated feature sets. DimHeatmap(dc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
